behavior_in_tests: The tests cover core recovery behavior but do not test several important documented requirements, including malformed requests generally, mode-count capping, calibration revisions 1 and 3, exact means/eigenvalues/eigenvectors, correction validation, and many invalid-phase nonmutation cases.
